kill_switch.behaviour: Provider enablement, identity, pinned model, request hash, Governor reservation and USD cap rechecked immediately before dispatch.

usd_ledger.behaviour: Interrupted, failed, rejected and validated attempts contribute to conservative liability; interrupted rows survive restart.

reuse_identity.behaviour: Reuse requires current/historical fingerprints, payload SHA-256, request SHA-256, provider, model and validator version; cache hits do not dispatch.

concurrency.behaviour: One consent can dispatch at most once; simultaneous attempts receive 409; withdrawal cannot interrupt an in-flight call.

invalid_output.behaviour: Malformed or weak evidence is rejected, raw output is retained, and no connection is created.
